text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Mejiro 
Dober—

Ngh... I can't give up searching! Hang in 
there a bit longer, my quadriceps!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Without a doubt, I think it's Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter? You look like you're in 
a bit of trouble...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "Dober...?! To tell the truth—"

Mejiro Ryan and her group were invited as 
guests to perform at a neighborhood 
association live event. However, it seems 
they were short-staffed due to an 
unexpected problem.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The concert starts this evening, but we 
haven't been able to find a replacement at 
all...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Dummy! I haven't even said anything 
yet."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Man, you got me. You see right through 
everything, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Ryan. Could you teach me the song 
and choreography for the Live?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Ryan. Could you teach me the song 
and choreography for the Live?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Could Dober be entering too!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That would be a huge help, but... are you 
sure you're okay with it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I'm completely fine, but... 
but...

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
Star light, star bright... Please let me 
become an amazing Umamusume who can win 
big races too...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As long as you take it one step at a time, 
you'll eventually reach the ideal vision 
both I and you are aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(...I will move forward. And just like I 
wished for when I was little—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I'll make sure not to get in the way. So 
please...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"A burden? Not at all! You're super, super 
dependable!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Dober. ...And to Dober's 
Trainer, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —Alright, and finish with a pose!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, looking great! I'm glad the outfit 
fits properly too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Looks like I might just make 
it to the concert in time.
choice_data_list:
I'm really looking forward to the live 
show!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Mm. I'll do everything I can.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
—Next up is what you've all been waiting 
for: a live stage performance by our 
special guests!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(A dream I wished for when I was little... 
A dream I almost gave up on, thinking it 
could never come true—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I'll reach out my hand again, together 
with Trainer...! That's why...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yay! It's a huge success, Dober!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah...... Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"They say there'll be fireworks to close 
out after the concert. Looks like they're 
starting right away."
choice_data_list: Once again, great work on the live!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list: I could really feel your feelings, Dober.

You were so poised and confident — you did 
great.

Aren't you going to an after-party with 
everyone?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thanks... Somehow, I feel like I've given 
it my all.
choice_data_list: I could really feel your feelings, Dober.

You were so poised and confident — you did 
great.

Aren't you going to an after-party with 
everyone?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Y-You never know until you try, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-I see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(But if my feelings really reached them, 
and everyone could see the new me—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If my feelings reached them, and everyone 
could see how much I've changed—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Performing the live concert... I'm so 
glad I mustered the courage.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I mustered the courage to do 
this concert.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...It's strange. These look way prettier 
than the fireworks I saw before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...It's strange. These look way prettier 
than the fireworks I saw before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Well, it's something I decided to do 
myself, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Well, it's something I decided to do 
myself, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I can't go looking pathetic in front of 
the crowd, or Dad—er, people I know, 
right?
choice_data_list: Your father is watching over you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I can't let anyone see me looking 
pathetic. Not the spectators... and not my 
father, either...
choice_data_list: Your father is watching over you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...I-It's fine! You don't have to watch 
me...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If they're watching, though, maybe they'll 
tone down the overprotectiveness a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Because then I'll be able to say, "See, 
nothing to worry about anymore, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...It's strange. These look way prettier 
than the fireworks I saw before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...It's strange. These look way prettier 
than the fireworks I saw before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I was invited, but... there were so many 
girls I didn't know. Plus, I just dropped 
in at the last minute, so—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I was invited, but... there were so many 
girls I didn't know. Plus, I just dropped 
in at the last minute, so—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I had to let you know that everything is 
all done, after all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I was just in the mood to 
quietly watch the fireworks with you, 
Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "...Um, hey. How was today's concert?"
choice_data_list: You were shining so brightly out there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. How was I today?
choice_data_list: You were shining so brightly out there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: H-Huh, I see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I... see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...It's strange. These look way prettier 
than the fireworks I saw before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...It's strange. These look way prettier 
than the fireworks I saw before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to grow even more and become a 
shining Umamusume... ...No, I WILL become 
one...!

Mejiro Dober looked up at the fireworks 
and made a vow. I reaffirmed in my heart 
that I would give my all to support her so 
she could fulfill that promise.
